text:
hibs: Midway Systems asked for a joint bench focusing on tokens/sec per watt and kernel tuning next month. They want a short methods appendix and the raw telemetry. Who can own runner + telemetry?

alex: I can own runner and telemetry. Recommend NVML @1s, PDU @2s, sync with chrony. We'll produce both raw tarball and a sanitized CSV.

joan: Workloads: steady long-context inference (6k) with phases batch=1,8,32. Each phase 30m steady + 10m ramp. Also do a KV-cache hit stress: 500 repeated prompts.

hibs: Good. Artifact naming: `midway-<date>-<site>-<gpu>-b<batch>.tgz`. S3 path `s3://redwood-partner-bench/midway/`. Put ACL group `midway-benchers`. Embargo requested until Aug 1.

alex: Runner example: `./bench --model=rw-3b --seq=6144 --batch=8 --nvml=1 --pdu=2 --trace-kv --out=midway-2026-08-run`

joan: Capture env: `uname -a`, `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,gpu_name --format=csv`, `cat /proc/modules | grep nvidia`. If any kernel tweaks, log them and change one knob at a time.

hibs: Schedule: internal smoke test Fri, partner run Tue next week, internal parity Thurs. Can everyone confirm?

alex: Confirmed. I'll push runner to `bench/interop/midway` and tag `v1.0-midway` by Thu EOD.

joan: I'll set S3 ACLs and draft embargo note for legal to sign off.

benchbot: created job `midway-bench-v1` and assigned `alex` as owner.

hibs: Action items: alex -> runner + canary, joan -> ACL + embargo, hibs -> coordinate site mapping. Reconvene Mon 9am PT to review smoke test logs.
